# Africa Guiding

> Independent African safari planning guides: best time to visit by country, the Great Migration, safari types, gorilla trekking in Rwanda and Uganda, packing and travel health.

Africa Guiding is an editorial travel-information site. It does not sell tours or permits. Health content is general information that points readers to the CDC and travel clinicians.

## Pages

- [Home](https://africaguiding.com/): Overview of the site with links to every safari planning guide and a safari FAQ.
- [Best Time for Safari in Africa, Country by Country](https://africaguiding.com/best-time-for-safari): Dry season, green season and month-by-month trade-offs for Africa's main safari countries.
- [The Great Migration: A Month-by-Month Guide](https://africaguiding.com/great-migration-guide): Where the wildebeest herds usually are each month, plus how to plan for river crossings and calving.
- [Choosing a Safari Type: Lodge, Mobile, Self-Drive and More](https://africaguiding.com/safari-types-lodge-mobile-self-drive): How lodges, tented camps, mobile, fly-in, overland and self-drive safaris differ, and who each one suits.
- [Gorilla Trekking in Rwanda and Uganda: A Practical Guide](https://africaguiding.com/gorilla-trekking-rwanda-uganda): Permits, fitness, rules and Rwanda-vs-Uganda choices for seeing mountain gorillas in the wild.
- [Safari Packing List: What to Wear and What to Bring](https://africaguiding.com/safari-packing-list): A practical checklist for clothes, gear, documents and soft-bag luggage limits on bush flights.
- [Africa Travel Health: Vaccines, Malaria and Staying Well on Safari](https://africaguiding.com/africa-travel-health): How to prepare for vaccines, malaria, sun, water and insurance &mdash; and where to find official advice.
